verses.sloka: तत्सर्वमखिलेनाशु प्रस्थाप्य भरताग्रजः ।हयं लक्षणसम्पन्नं कृष्णसारं मुमोच ह ।। ७.९२.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: tatsarvamakhilenāśu prasthāpya bharatāgrajaḥ ।hayaṁ lakṣaṇasampannaṁ kṛṣṇasāraṁ mumoca ha ।। 7.92.1 ॥

translations.english: Having quickly sent forth all those arrangements completely, Rama, Bharata's elder brother, then released the black-spotted horse, which was endowed with auspicious marks, for the sacrifice.

verses.sloka: ऋत्विग्भिर्लक्ष्मणं सार्धमश्वतन्त्रे नियोज्य च ।ततो ऽभ्यगच्छत्काकुत्स्थः सह सैन्येन नैमिशम् ।। ७.९२.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtvigbhirlakṣmaṇaṁ sārdhamaśvatantre niyojya ca ।tato 'bhyagacchatkākutsthaḥ saha sainyena naimiśam ।। 7.92.2 ॥

translations.english: After appointing Lakshmana along with the priests to supervise the sacrificial horse, Rama then proceeded towards Naimisha with his army.
translations.hindi: हे राग ! में शूद्र हुँ । शूद्रकुल में मेरा जन्म हुआ। है। में इसी शारीर से स्वग जाने की कामना से अथवा दिव्यत्व प्राप्त करने की इच्छा से, ऐसा उम्र तप कर रहा हूँ

verses.sloka: यज्ञवाटं महाबाहुर्दृष्ट्वा परममद्भुतम् ।प्रबर्षमतुलं लेभे श्रीमानिति वचो ऽब्रवीत् ।। ७.९२.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: yajñavāṭaṁ mahābāhurdṛṣṭvā paramamadbhutam ।prabarṣamatulaṁ lebhe śrīmāniti vaco 'bravīt ।। 7.92.3 ॥

translations.english: Having seen the extremely wonderful sacrificial enclosure, the glorious and mighty-armed Rama felt incomparable joy and spoke these words.
translations.hindi: प्रमो ! में देवलोक जाना चाहता हूँ । अतः झुठ नहों बोलता । सुके आप शूद्र जानिए । मेरा नाम शम्वूक है

verses.sloka: नैमिषे वसतस्तस्य सर्व एव नराधिपाः ।आनिन्युरुपहारांश्च तान्रामः प्रत्यपूजयत् ।। ७.९२.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: naimiṣe vasatastasya sarva eva narādhipāḥ ।āninyurupahārāṁśca tānrāmaḥ pratyapūjayat ।। 7.92.4 ॥

translations.english: While Rama was residing in Naimisha, all the kings brought him gifts, and Rama, in turn, honored them.

verses.sloka: उपकार्या महार्हाश्च पार्थिवानां महात्मनाम् ।सानुगानां नरश्रेष्ठो व्यादिदेश महामतिः ।। ७.९२.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: upakāryā mahārhāśca pārthivānāṁ mahātmanām ।sānugānāṁ naraśreṣṭho vyādideśa mahāmatiḥ ।। 7.92.5 ॥

translations.english: The great-minded Rama, the best among men, arranged for valuable and suitable lodgings for the great kings and their retinues.

verses.sloka: अन्नपानानि वस्त्राणि सानुगानां महात्मनाम् ।भरतः सन्ददावाशु शत्रुघ्नसहितस्तदा ।। ७.९२.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: annapānāni vastrāṇi sānugānāṁ mahātmanām ।bharataḥ sandadāvāśu śatrughnasahitastadā ।। 7.92.6 ॥

translations.english: Bharata, accompanied by Shatrughna, then swiftly provided food, drinks, and clothes for the great-souled kings and their followers.
translations.hindi: षट्सप्ततितमः सगः ७३१ उसी समय दिव्य सुगन्धित पुष्पों की बृष्टि हुई। वायु से गिराए हुए फूल चारों ओर विखर गए

verses.sloka: वानराश्च महात्मानः सुग्रीवसहितास्तदा ।विप्राणां प्रणताः सर्वे चक्रिरे परिवेषणम् ।। ७.९२.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: vānarāśca mahātmānaḥ sugrīvasahitāstadā ।viprāṇāṁ praṇatāḥ sarve cakrire pariveṣaṇam ।। 7.92.7 ॥

translations.english: Then, all the great-souled Vanaras, led by Sugriva, humbly served food to the Brahmins.
translations.hindi: सत्यपराक्रमी श्रीरामचन्द्र जी से प्रसन्न हो कर, समस्त देवता कहने लगे-हे महामते ! तुम ने देवताओं का यह बड़ा भारी काम किआ है

verses.sloka: बिभीषणश्च रक्षोभिर्बहुभिः स्रग्विभिर्वृतः ।ऋषीणामुग्रतपसां पूजां चक्रे महात्मनाम् ।। ७.९२.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: bibhīṣaṇaśca rakṣobhirbahubhiḥ sragvibhirvṛtaḥ ।ṛṣīṇāmugratapasāṁ pūjāṁ cakre mahātmanām ।। 7.92.8 ॥

translations.english: Vibhishana, accompanied by many garland-wearing Rakshasas, performed worship for the great-souled sages of severe penance.
translations.hindi: हे शत्रुतापन सौम्य श्रीरामचन्द्र ! तुम्हारी कृपा दी से यहद शुद्र जाति का मनुष्य हमारे स्त्रगं में नहीं आने पाया । हे अरि- नन्दन ! अतः तुम जो चाहते हो सो हमसे बर माँग लो

verses.sloka: एवं सुविहितो यज्ञो हयमेधो ऽभ्यवर्तत ।लक्ष्मणेनागुप्ता च हयचर्या प्रवर्तत ।ईदृशं राजसिंहस्य यज्ञप्रवरमुत्तमम् ।। ७.९२.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: evaṁ suvihito yajño hayamedho 'bhyavartata ।lakṣmaṇenāguptā ca hayacaryā pravartata ।īdṛśaṁ rājasiṁhasya yajñapravaramuttamam ।। 7.92.9 ॥

translations.english: Thus, the well-arranged Ashvamedha sacrifice proceeded, and the horse's journey, unguarded by Lakshmana, also took place, such was this excellent and supreme sacrifice of the lion among kings.

verses.sloka: नान्यः शब्दो ऽभवत्तत्र हयमेधे महात्मनः ।छन्दतो देहि विस्रब्धो यावत्तुष्यन्ति याचकाः ।। ७.९२.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: nānyaḥ śabdo 'bhavattatra hayamedhe mahātmanaḥ ।chandato dehi visrabdho yāvattuṣyanti yācakāḥ ।। 7.92.10 ॥

translations.english: In the great-souled Rama's Ashvamedha, no other sound was heard except "Give freely and confidently until the supplicants are satisfied."
translations.hindi: यदि आप सब देवता मेरे ऊपर प्रसन्न हैं, तो मुझे यद्दी मुँइमाँगा बर दीजिए कि बह त्राह्मणबालक जी उठे

verses.sloka: तावत्सर्वाणि दत्तानि क्रतुमध्ये महात्मनः ।विविधानि च गौडानि खाण्डवानि तथैव च ।। ७.९२.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: tāvatsarvāṇi dattāni kratumadhye mahātmanaḥ ।vividhāni ca gauḍāni khāṇḍavāni tathaiva ca ।। 7.92.11 ॥

translations.english: In the midst of the great-souled one's sacrifice, all sorts of things were given, including various jaggery sweets and sugar sweets.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि हे देवगण ! मेरे ही अपचार से उस ब्राह्मण का बह इकलौता पुत्र असमय मरा है

translations.english: Before a word could even emerge from the lips of the supplicants, it was already seen to be given by the monkeys and rakshasas.
translations.hindi: हे देवताओं ! आपका मज्गल हो। आप उस ब्राह्मणबालक को जिला दे. क्योंकि में उससे उस बालक को जीवित कर देने की प्रतिज्ञा करके आया हूँ । मेरी वह प्रतिज्ञा अन्यथा न होनी चाहिए

verses.sloka: न कश्चिन्मलिनस्तत्र दीनो वा ऽप्यथ कृर्शतः ।तस्मिन्यज्ञवरे राज्ञो हृष्टपुष्टजनावृते ।। ७.९२.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: na kaścinmalinastatra dīno vā 'pyatha kṛrśataḥ ।tasminyajñavare rājño hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāvṛte ।। 7.92.13 ॥

translations.english: In that excellent sacrifice of the king, which was filled with happy and well-nourished people, there was no one who was dirty, poor, or emaciated.

verses.sloka: ये च तत्र महात्मानो मुनयश्चिरजीविनः ।नास्मरंस्तादृशं यज्ञं नाप्यासीत् स कदाचन ।। ७.९२.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: ye ca tatra mahātmāno munayaścirajīvinaḥ ।nāsmaraṁstādṛśaṁ yajñaṁ nāpyāsīt sa kadācana ।। 7.92.14 ॥

translations.english: Even the great-souled, long-lived sages present there had never remembered or witnessed such a sacrifice before.

verses.sloka: यः कृत्यवान्सुवर्णेन सुवर्णं लभते स्म सः ।वित्तार्थी लभते वित्तं रत्नार्थी रत्नमेव च ।। ७.९२.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: yaḥ kṛtyavānsuvarṇena suvarṇaṁ labhate sma saḥ ।vittārthī labhate vittaṁ ratnārthī ratnameva ca ।। 7.92.15 ॥

translations.english: Whoever had a need for gold obtained gold, those desiring wealth obtained wealth, and those desiring jewels indeed obtained jewels.
translations.hindi: हे राम ! जिस समय तुमने इस शूद्र को मारा था, वह बालक तो उसी समय जी उठा था

verses.sloka: रजतानां सुवर्णानामश्मनामथ वाससाम् ।अनिशं दीयमानानां राशिः समुपदृश्यते ।। ७.९२.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: rajatānāṁ suvarṇānāmaśmanāmatha vāsasām ।aniśaṁ dīyamānānāṁ rāśiḥ samupadṛśyate ।। 7.92.16 ॥

translations.english: Heaps of silver, gold, jewels, and clothes, constantly being distributed, were visible everywhere.
translations.hindi: सा ७५ हे राघव ! आपका मङ्गल हो । अब दम लोग अगस्त्य जी के श्रेष्ठ आश्रम को देखने जाते हैं

verses.sloka: न शक्रस्य धनेशस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य वा ।ईदृशो दृष्टपूर्वो न एवमूचुस्तपोधनाः ।। ७.९२.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: na śakrasya dhaneśasya yamasya varuṇasya vā ।īdṛśo dṛṣṭapūrvo na evamūcustapodhanāḥ ।। 7.92.17 ॥

translations.english: The ascetics declared that such a spectacle had never been seen before, not even in the realms of Indra, Kubera, Yama, or Varuna.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि उन महातेजस्वी ऋषि की आज उस यज्ञदीक्षा का अन्तिम दिवस है, जिसके कारण वे बारह,बर्षा से जल में सोया करते थे

verses.sloka: सर्वत्र वानरास्तस्थुः सर्वत्रैव च राक्षसाः ।वासोधनान्नमर्थिभ्यः पूर्णहस्ता ददुर्भृशम् ।। ७.९२.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: sarvatra vānarāstasthuḥ sarvatraiva ca rākṣasāḥ ।vāsodhanānnamarthibhyaḥ pūrṇahastā dadurbhṛśam ।। 7.92.18 ॥

translations.english: Monkeys and rakshasas were present everywhere, giving clothes, wealth, and food abundantly with full hands to all who sought them.
translations.hindi: हे राम ! हम लोग वहाँ जा कर, उनका अभिनन्दन करेंगे । तुम्हारा मङ्गल हो | तुम भो उन ऋषिश्रेष्ठ का दर्शन करने को बहाँ चलो

verses.sloka: ईदृशो राजसिंहस्य यज्ञः सर्वगुणान्वितः ।संवत्सरमथो साग्रं वर्तते न च हीयते ।। ७.९२.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: īdṛśo rājasiṁhasya yajñaḥ sarvaguṇānvitaḥ ।saṁvatsaramatho sāgraṁ vartate na ca hīyate ।। 7.92.19 ।।

translations.english: Such a sacrifice of the lion among kings, endowed with all good qualities, continued for more than a year without diminishing. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्विनवतितमः सर्गः ।। 92 ।। Thus ends the ninety-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
